description.value: Banana Leaf is Vancouver's original Malaysian restaurant, established in 1995 and now operating five locations across Metro Vancouver, including this Davie Street outpost in the West End. The menu draws on Malaysian, Indonesian, Singaporean, Thai, Chinese, and Indian influences, offering over 40 dishes from Roti Canai to Beef Rendang. The Davie location is wheelchair accessible and offers both dine-in and takeout.

No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the website, and OSM tags carry no bike-specific data; outdoor_seating=no (OSM) eliminates patio visibility as a parking option. The restaurant is clearly active (OSM check_date 2026-05-03, website current).

OSM outdoor_seating=no eliminates patio/window visibility as a passive bike-watching option; no alternative bike parking evidence found.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is a well-established, accessible food stop on a busy cycling corridor, but none of the key WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify at least bike parking before listing.
